email.subject: All Out of Time
email.body:
Congratulations!
You just completed the AvCon demo of Hacknet! The alpha version of the game is already released, and you can get it for free on Desura or IndieCity. The game is still in development, and i'm working to finish it prorely and make it the best game it can be before it's next release.
Please let me know what you thought of the game, and if you have any suggestions for the future of it.
Thanks for playing!
--Matt Trobbiani
P.S: If you want more, the linked server might have some clues...
